A [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was the '''homeworld''' of the [[Tzorbi]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] that was one of the first to join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] but went extinct thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Remembering the Lost}}</ref>
